ov: قطار منتصف الليل (الإنجليزية: Midnight Express) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة والمملكة المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1978 وقصة الفيلم مقتبسة من القصة الحقيقة للمؤلف بيلي هايز الذي تعرض لمعاناة شديدة في السجن وتمكن في الفرار في النهاية.
plotEn:
Returning from a trip to Istanbul with his girlfriend, American college student Billy Hayes straps 2 kg (4.4 lb) of hashish bricks to his chest with the intent to smuggle the drug into the United States where he will sell it. 
At the Yeşilköy Airport, Billy is frisked by soldiers who discover the hidden hashish, leading to his arrest and strip-search. An American operative nicknamed "Tex" arrives to translate and assist police. Billy claims he purchased the drugs from a taxi driver and offers to identify the driver in exchange for his own release. He is taken to a local market where Billy points out the driver. As police approach, Billy attempts to flee but encounters Tex, who recaptures him at gunpoint.
During his first night at Sultanahmet Jail, Billy sneaks out of his cell to steal a blanket and is subsequently beaten by chief guard Hamidou. He awakens days later at Sağmalcılar Prison among fellow Western inmates: Jimmy, an American thief; Max, an English heroin addict; and Erich, a Swedish smuggler. Jimmy warns Billy that foreigners face extreme danger in the prison and that no one can be trusted.
Billy is visited by his father and a Turkish attorney to discuss his defense. At the trial, the prosecutor argues for a smuggling conviction, but a sympathetic lead judge sentences Billy to four years for the lesser crime of possession.
